subtitle: An 18-kilometer beach and buried Lycian capital that Turkey placed under a construction ban in 1990 to save nesting loggerhead turtles — a ban conservationists say hundreds of buildings have gone up inside anyway.
spike_statement: A 1990 law banned construction on Patara's 18km beach to save nesting turtles and buried ruins; 255 holiday homes rose inside the protected zone anyway by 2018.

levers.photo_tone: Flat gold dune-sand under hard Mediterranean sun, turquoise shallows, and half-buried Roman stone breaking through grass-stitched dunes.
